name: Krannert Building
scope: Read-only interpretation of existing official Purdue GIS vertical fields against the preserved Krannert builder datums. No asset, geometry, placement, master, manifest, or shared files changed.

field_metadata_findings.aliases: The returned aliases repeat the field names; no units or semantic descriptions are supplied.
field_metadata_findings.interpretation: Values are consistent with feet, but that unit is inferred rather than specified by the available layer schema. The relationship of Elevation, G, R and Extrution to a vertical datum or to one another is not documented.

comparison_method: For a conditional feet interpretation, subtract the raw G value from F01-F07 and R, then compare those differences with the builder's ground-relative floor/roof datums. This is an internal consistency check against values the model was already built from, not independent as-built measurement.

roof_semantics_review.extrution: The raw value 108 numerically matches the builder's +108 ft parapet top only if interpreted as an above-ground feet field; schema does not define this.
roof_semantics_review.r: R=117 matches the builder's +117 ft penthouse top if treated as an above-ground feet field, while R-G=104.3 matches the builder roof-deck datum. Without field semantics, it is unclear whether R denotes a roof-deck elevation in the same datum as G or a roof/penthouse height above grade.
roof_semantics_review.assessment: Do not use this numeric pattern alone to claim verified parapet, roof deck, penthouse, or overall building height. Retain the existing roof/attribute ambiguity.

result: The F01-F07 sequence is internally consistent with the builder's ground-relative floor datums under a feet/common-datum interpretation. Because the model was derived from these same GIS values and the GIS units/semantics are undocumented, this does not independently verify actual floor heights. Roof fields remain ambiguous.
saved_asset_reopen_validation: Existing audit/batch2_krannert/validation_round4.json remains the latest saved-source reopen check; this evidence-only supplement did not change the asset.
